customManagers.description: Track the vendored HetrixTools agent version (re-vendor on bump)

Update pinned Alpine apk packages via the custom.alpine CDN datasource. IMPORTANT: bump the alpine version in depNameTemplate when the base image changes (e.g. alpine_3_24 -> alpine_3_25); it drives both the depName and the registry URL. All pins here live in the Alpine main repository; a package from community would be SILENTLY untracked without a registryUrls packageRule. See owine/renovate-config README.
